features: PREMIUM QUALITY - Our pre-filters greatly reduce the amount of dust & particles getting into your main HEPA filter. Replacing your main HEPA filter is costly so with 6 pre-filters, you can save both time & money.
MAKE YOUR HOME ODOR FREE - Made from Premium Quality Activated Carbon to help remove odor, smells and smoke. Ideal for pets, cooking, smokers & people suffering from asthma or allergies.

GREAT FIT - Compatible with Germ Guardian Air Purifier Models AC4300BPTCA, AC4900CA, AC4825, AC4850PT, FLT4825 Filter B, AP2200CA, and BXAP148. We include step-by-step instructions for quick and easy installation every time. Pre-Filter Dimensions: H: 15.75” x L: 4.72” x W 0.2”

description: Our Mission is to Keep Your Home Smelling Fresh and Clean with our Activated Carbon Pre-Filters!

Pet owners, smokers, people suffering from asthma or allergies trust VEVA Advanced Filters for their needs, whether to remove odors, smells, allergens, dander, pollen, pet hair, dust or smoke from their household.
Each pack including 6 pre-filters extends the life of your HEPA filter by effectively capturing dust and small particles. No HEPA filters are included in this pack.

Replace your dirty old filter in matter of minutes! These are specially cut and designed to fit Air Purifier Models AC4300BPTCA, AC4900CA, AC4825, AC4850PT, AP2200CA, and BXAP148. Pre-Filter Dimensions: H: 15.75” x L: 4.72” x W 0.2”
